class.name: IfcVertex
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A vertex is the topological construct corresponding to a point. It has dimensionality 0 and extent 0. The domain of a vertex, if present, is a point in m dimensional real space R M ; this is represented by the vertex point subtype. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: vertex.
